name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2020-03-04.115.5) to suspend the usual procedural rules - known as [standing orders](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/parliament-at-work/standing-orders/) - so that the [third reading motion](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) can be moved without delay. To read a bill for a third time is to pass it in the House.
